text:
Alice: Morning — quick proposal for next week's triage: shorten to 30m, rotate owners across a 3-person pool (Mon/Wed/Fri), and add a short pre-triage checklist posted 1h before. Also propose a 10m 'fast RFC' slot twice a month for quick design checks.

Ben: I'm +1 on 30m if we tighten agenda. Suggest: 10m new bugs, 10m owner updates, 10m follow-ups/hand-offs.

Carla: @Ben good structure. For rotation pool: me, Alice, Dan as primary owners; backups: Ben, Elena. Can we try this for 4 weeks then assess?

Dan: Works for me. Quick note: if we shorten, we need pre-triage to be high quality — otherwise we waste time. I can add a tiny checklist and a Slack thread template.

Alice: here's a draft pre-triage checklist (post 1h before):

```
- top 3 items by severity/age
- owner assigned + short context (1 line)
- any blocking infra or rollout notes
- link to bug/PR and locale reproduction steps if needed
```

Elena: Love the checklist. For the fast RFC slot: can we reserve the 2nd and 4th Friday 10:15-10:25? Keep it async-first — attach 2-pager before the meeting.

Ben: Small ask — add a one-line expected outcome for each agenda item (e.g., 'decide owner', 'defer to follow-up', 'schedule deep dive'). Helps keep 30m tight.

Carla: Agreed. We'll trial Mon/Wed/Fri owner rotation starting next Monday. I'll update the calendar invite and ping the on-call rota for conflicts.

triage-bot: Reminder scheduled: Pre-triage checklist will be posted to #eng 1h before triage next Mon. Use `/triage post-checklist` to preview.

Dan: One more ops note — can owners set the triage doc's priority column before the meeting? Even simple P0/P1/P2 will speed things up.

Alice: Yep. I'll update the template and post it now. Link: https://redwood.share/triage-templates/short-checklist (preview in thread).

Ben: :thumbsup: If nobody objects, consider this approved and we'll run the 4-week pilot.

Elena: no objections from product side.

Carla: OK locked in. I'll send the updated invite and add the 4-week review on the calendar. Thanks all. :rocket:
